title: India's Emergency That Was Never Used #shorts
sources: Constitution of India, Article 360 (financial emergency; 360(2)(c) approval by both Houses within two months; 360(4)(b) reduction of salaries incl. Supreme Court and High Court judges) - legislative.gov.in
Financial emergency has never been proclaimed in India - Vajiram & Ravi, 'Financial Emergency, Article 360' (vajiramandravi.com/upsc-exam/financial-emergency/)
PYQ: UPSC Prelims 2007, 'Consider the following statements in respect of financial emergency under Article 360...' answer (a) 1 only - pmfias.com/financial-emergency-article-360-pyq-2007/
PYQ: UPSC Mains 2018 GS-II, 'Under what circumstances can the Financial Emergency be proclaimed by the President of India?...' - superkalam.com and dalvoy.com UPSC Mains 2018 GS-II archives

lines.text: India has an emergency it has never used, not even once.
Article three sixty, the Financial Emergency.
Under it, the President can even cut the salaries of judges.
UPSC asked this in Prelims two thousand seven and Mains twenty eighteen.
So, which option is correct? Tell me in the comments.
